note: 采访八百壮士的一天 sound plan v1 (26 Nov). Levels are written as targets in the mix (beds and music: lufs; hits: peak dBFS); scripts/sihang/sound/level_cues.py turns them into the static gains of cues.json. NO MUSIC in scene D and none under the letter scenes; the only music is the flag's shadow (F) and the end slate (after her camera dies). The enemy has no sound of his own but his shells and his fire. Scene D: the blast, a ring in the ears, then almost nothing.
